name: Sore ga Bokura no Ren'ai Seikatsu Fandisc
original_name: それが僕等の恋愛生活 Fandisc
source:
Three months later main character finally gets used to the life in dormitory. Today he feels lonely and starts walking around the campus to try to find the soul mate.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三個月後，主角終於習慣了宿舍生活。今天，他感到孤獨，於是開始在校園裡四處走動，試圖尋找靈魂伴侶。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]VNDB Review[/url]］
